title: 161. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price 1) sell on day 3 (price 5) profit 4; buy on day 4 (price 3) sell on day 5 (price 6) profit 3; total 7.
Buy on day 1 (price 1) and sell on day 5 (price 5), profit 4.
No profitable transaction exists, so profit is 0.

hints: Sum every positive day-to-day difference: profit += max(0, prices[i]-prices[i-1]).
This greedy equals unlimited transactions since each uphill step can be captured.
